clos.loDetails: Understanding the classical and modern theory of management and the importance of management in profit-making organizations and non-profit organizations.
Understanding the functions of management such as planning, organizing, leading, and controlling

Analyzing the environment of an organization (internal and external environment) to realize opportunities, threats, strength, and weakness (hereafter SWOT) which are information establishing the strategies to develop the organization.
Developing and applying conceptual skills, technical skill, human skills, and making decisions skill.
